title: Object sprites
description: The graphics the preview's DE textures view draws objects with (docs/preview-de-textures-design.md Sec.12). Written by `python tools/extract-constants/extract_constants.py --object-data` from empires2_x2_p1.dat, beside object-data.json. Never edited by hand.

sprites.description: Graphic id to [file, frames, angles, mirroring, layer, deltas].

prefixItems.description: SLD base name in drs/graphics, empty for a graphic with no picture.
Angles, a tree's or a mine's variants among them.
The dat's mirroring mode, non zero when later angles are mirrors.
Parts drawn in order, [graphic, x, y], -1 being the graphic itself, offsets in sprite pixels.
